name: Telegram Node Monitor
description: Periodically checks active servers using Globalping API to verify TCP connectivity from Chinese probes and alerts via Telegram.
author: Antigravity

tg_chat_id.label: Admin Chat ID
tg_chat_id.description: The Telegram Chat ID or Group ID to send notifications to.

check_interval.label: Check Interval (Minutes)
check_interval.description: How often to check node connectivity in minutes (e.g. 5, 10, 15, 30, 60).

fail_threshold_percent.label: Failure Threshold (%)
fail_threshold_percent.description: Trigger alert if this percentage or more of Chinese probes fail to connect (e.g. 50).

globalping_token.label: Globalping API Token (Optional)
globalping_token.description: Optional API token from globalping.io dashboard. Provides higher rate limits. Leave empty for anonymous access.

cn_probe_limit.label: CN Probe Count
cn_probe_limit.description: Number of Chinese probes to use per check (1-10). More probes = more accurate but uses more API quota.
